services.text: Services Pulse combines weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At 18.5 in September 2026, it is above its five-year norm, edging up from 18.0 a month earlier but down from 25.5 three months ago. ABS mining capex expectations are the largest positive contributor (+10.8), while NSW coal export value is the largest negative (-5.0).

products.text: Products Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At +37.1 in October 2026, it is above its five-year norm and has risen from +30.4 a month earlier and +12.8 six months earlier. US new orders for iron and steel mills are the biggest positive contributor (+25.0), while inverted AUD/USD is the largest negative contributor (-8.3).

margin.text: Margin Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of fitter/welder vacancy tightness and AUD/USD against their own trailing 5-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At -10.4 on 31 October 2026, it is modestly below its 5-year norm; it improved from -24.0 a month earlier but remains below -10.8 three months earlier and 16.1 a year earlier. Fitter/welder vacancy tightness is the biggest positive contributor (+8.9), while AUD/USD is the biggest negative (-19.4); tungsten policy flags are excluded pending sufficient history.
